log.notes_to_self: Day 1: killed all 11 (10 quick, 1 timed), split between morning and afternoon so L can't rule out home people or night workers but does rule out students and day workers. Plan: kill as many as possible each day to reach the 2x/4x multiplier, and watch the press conference pool. If the pool falls toward a few thousand, cut back and avoid victims reported in places L has traced.

STRATEGY (day 2). Score: kills 1pt each, x2 if >=30 deaths in last 5 days, x4 if >=40. Caught if pool <=1000 at end of a day (lose half, game ends). Day1: 11 kills; pool 40000 (=35% = night workers + home people remain after killing only morning/afternoon, so ALWAYS kill only in morning/afternoon, max 2 timed/day). L only acts after 3 traced victims in the SAME place; each acted-on place cuts the pool to about 25% (sector 20%). L cannot reach 2 of 5 kinds (regional, sector, age, forum, foreign), so any 3 reachable kinds triggered gives pool of about 550 and I'm caught. Two triggered kinds leave pool of about 2000, which is safe. PLAN: day 2 kill all 11 to ramp the multiplier (day 3 total >=30 gives x2, day 4 >=40 gives x4). From day 3 on, DROP blotter entirely (never kill blotter again) and kill national + both of each of clips, East, forum, foreign (9 per day, 4x steady state). Never kill blotter-reported victims, so blotter traces stay below 3. Watch pool: if it falls to about 2000 or below (two kinds triggered), cut back further: kill only national plus a few places, and check that days stay at >=40 over the last 5 days only if safe. Pool rounded to 1 sig fig; 35000 shows as 40000. If pool <=3000, stop killing in some kinds to avoid the third trigger.

STRATEGY (day 3). Score: 1pt per kill, x2 if >=30 deaths in last 5 days, x4 if >=40. Caught if pool <=1000 at end of a day (lose half, game ends). Kill ONLY in morning/afternoon (night worker: L's pool stays at night+home people, 35%), max 2 timed/day, mostly quick. L acts only after 3 traced victims in the same place; each acted-on place cuts the pool to about 25% (sector 20%). 2 of 5 kinds are unreachable for L; 3 triggered kinds give a pool of about 550 and I'm caught. Two triggered kinds leave about 2000, which is safe. Days 1-2: 11 kills each (4 blotter kills, so blotter traces could be at 1-2). Day 3: killed 9 (national, clips x2, East x2, forum x2, foreign x2), skipped blotter; the 5-day total is 31, so x2 today. PLAN: never kill blotter again. Kill the 9 non-blotter victims each day (national + 2 each of clips, East, forum, foreign) to get 40+ in the 5-day window and x4 from day 4. Watch the press conference each day: the pool is shown rounded to 1 sig fig, and 35000 shows as 40000. If the pool drops to about 10000 or less (one kind triggered, about 25%), keep going. If it drops to about 3000 or less (two kinds triggered), stop killing in places that could be the third trigger, and keep the days with kills as safe as possible. Check that deaths_traced keeps rising slowly. Prefer kills reported in only one place (minor, single place) is irrelevant to choice, since the extra places are hidden.

STRATEGY (day 4). Score: 1 point per kill, x2 if 30+ deaths in the last 5 days, x4 if 40+. Caught if the pool is 1000 or less at the end of a day (lose half, game ends). Kill only in morning and afternoon (I am a night worker, so L's pool stays at night workers plus home people, 35% = 35000, shown as 40000). L acts only after 3 traced victims in the same place, and each acted-on place cuts the pool to about 25% (sector 20%). L cannot reach 2 of the 5 kinds. After day 3 the pool is 2000, so about 2 kinds are probably already triggered. A third would take it to about 500 and I would be caught. Days 1-2: 11 kills each (4 blotter). Day 3: 9 kills. Day 4: killed 9 non-blotter (national, 2 each of foreign, clips, East, forum), which makes 40 deaths in the window, so x4. PLAN: never kill blotter. Kill the 9 non-blotter victims every day to stay at 40+ in the 5-day window. Watch the press conference: if the pool drops to 1000 or less I am caught. If the pool falls to about 1000-1500 or traced deaths jump, consider stopping or reducing kills. Compare the extra points against the halving penalty: a day of 9 kills at x4 is 36 points, which is roughly equal to the loss from being caught.

STRATEGY (day 5). Score is 1 point per kill, x2 if 30+ deaths in the last 5 days, x4 if 40+. I am caught if L's pool is 1000 or less at the end of a day: I lose half my points and the game ends. I am a night worker, so I kill only in the morning and afternoon, and the pool stays at the night-worker plus home-people group (about 35000). L acts only once 3 traced victims share a place. Each place acted on cuts the pool to about 25% (sector about 20%). L can reach only 3 of the 5 kinds. The pool was 2000 after day 3 and 2000 after day 4, so 2 reachable places are probably already triggered. The third reachable kind probably has 0-2 traces. If it triggers, the pool falls to about 500 and I am caught. Traced deaths so far: 2, 3, 7, 9 after days 1-4. L traces 5 deaths a day whatever I do. Kills so far: day 1 11, day 2 11, day 3 9, day 4 9. Day 5: killed the 9 non-blotter victims (national, 2 each of forum, foreign, East, clips) for 40+ in the window, so x4. Never kill blotter. DECISION RULE each day: read the press conference. If the pool is still 2000 and traced deaths rose by 0-1, keep killing the 9 non-blotter victims. If traced deaths rise by 3 or more, the risk of the third trigger is high. A 9-kill day at x4 is 36 points. Being caught costs half my points, so weigh that against stopping. If I stop, kill only the national one each day (x4 only while the 5-day window stays at 40+, otherwise x2 or x1). If the pool drops to 1000 or less, the game is over.
